label: Deblur
blurb: Undoes a small, even blur of a known shape rather than sharpening edges: a shot slightly out of focus (a disc) or smeared by a shake or a pan (a line at an angle). It works back towards the picture that, blurred that way, gives what you see, a few steps at a time, holding every pixel inside the range of its neighbours so no halos grow. Match the blur size to the blur in the shot; too big rings, too small does little.
